title: Baltimore vs Carolina: 1st Half Point Total

contracts.label: More than 3.5 points scored in the 1st half

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Baltimore and Carolina collectively score more than 3.5 points during the 1st half of the Pro Football game between Baltimore and Carolina scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the total points scored by both teams during the 1st half of the specified game, excluding all other periods and overtime.
